items.title: India news: Sonam Wangchuk says he is under house arrest in Ladakh
items.titleOrig: India news: Sonam Wangchuk says he is under house arrest in Ladakh
items.desc: Wangchuk is among activists in Ladakh who have raised concerns about upcoming regional elections, which they say are designed to diminish voter participation as they will be held in the harsh winter period. DW has more.

items.title: US disrupts North Korea's $400 million crypto scam, FBI says
items.titleOrig: US disrupts North Korea's $400 million crypto scam, FBI says
items.desc: The US has seized servers linked to a North Korean scam that used fake video meetings and deepfakes to steal more than $400 million in crypto, and has moved to seize $1.2 billion that was taken from Binance.

items.title: Darth Vader strikes back at auction as his lightsaber from two original Star Wars films reclaims the record from Luke Skywalker's prop
items.titleOrig: Darth Vader strikes back at auction as his lightsaber from two original Star Wars films reclaims the record from Luke Skywalker's prop
items.desc: Darth Vader's lightsaber sold for nearly $5 million, breaking the record set by Luke Skywalker's in July. The hilt, made from a 1950s camera flash attachment, was used in two of the original trilogy's duels.

items.title: FIFA loses bid to block UEFA evidence gathering against Infantino
items.titleOrig: FIFA loses bid to block UEFA evidence gathering against Infantino
items.desc: A New York judge has dismissed soccer governing body FIFA's attempts to shield its president from investigation. Europe's UEFA is seeking evidence of wrongdoing by Gianni Infantino.

items.title: EU leaders tussle over whom to send to Ukraine, Russia peace talks
items.titleOrig: EU leaders tussle over whom to send to Ukraine, Russia peace talks
items.desc: A seat at the table for Europe now appears likely following comments by a US envoy who just held talks with Putin. But who will take that seat remains unclear.

items.title: Pete Hegseth honors soldier who scolded him at Arlington cemetery
items.titleOrig: Pete Hegseth honors soldier who scolded him at Arlington cemetery
items.desc: The soldier had reprimanded the US defense secretary and his group after they were heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The site is one of the most solemn military memorials in the US.

items.title: Nigeria: Axe-wielding men attack opposition campaign rally in Lagos
items.titleOrig: Nigeria: Axe-wielding men attack opposition campaign rally in Lagos
items.desc: A group of men armed with axes, clubs and machetes have reportedly attacked an opposition rally in the run-up to presidential elections. Journalists were also attacked as victims pointed fingers at the ruling APC party.
